goal:
Fix seven defects found in CARD-0527's round-1 review (task 89bfbbdf). Subject commit: 2193e8fad782a0578d84f43e28ff9d9da31be4d2 on branch feat/card-task-2853f966, worktree C:\Antiphon\worktrees\card-task-2853f966 (fetch/checkout that branch first if not already tip). Full details: C:/Antiphon/evidence/review-89bfbbdf/review-findings.md (in that path or the equivalent in this worktree if copied).

F1 (GatedCommitService.cs:87): ignore-rule validation misses a rename's OldPath, breaking the unchanged-rules guarantee - validate both rename endpoints; add regression coverage and a control.
F2 (GitWorkspaceService.cs:729): a failed ignore check becomes an empty match list, permitting a commit without a valid safety check - propagate the inspection failure and refuse mutation instead.
F3 (AgentTaskReplyService.cs:1548): settlement saves before note enqueue; a crash or insertion failure between them can lose the notification, so the claimed atomic boundary doesn't actually exist - persist a recoverable notification obligation and prove complete UserPrompt receipt across failures.
F4 (DelegationReportFormatter.cs:214): Shared/Never-Commit children still receive a 'Do NOT commit or push' instruction with no test delivering an actual spawned child's complete brief through the queue - separate automatic-settlement policy from explicit commit authority and test the complete child chain.
F5 (AgentTaskReplyService.cs:3196): the push audit compares upstream against the previous LOCAL HEAD instead of an independent baseline, producing incorrect warnings or missed movement - store and compare an independent upstream baseline.
F6 (AgentTaskReplyService.cs:2971): any commit mentioning the task GUID short-circuits settlement, which can hide remaining uncommitted work - validate exact settlement identity and trailers; cover partial commits and retries.
F7: two confirmed Unit regressions (SpecialistRoleContractTests.no_Check_comparison_survives_outside_the_allowlist, DelegationHarnessCensusTests.RuleD_GitWorkspaceService_one_liner_only_in_the_helper_and_its_pin) plus missing required Unit lane execution and missing R-17 contract evidence - fix the regressions, run the full required Unit lane, and execute R-17.

Full verification details: C:/Antiphon/evidence/review-89bfbbdf/verification.md. Rerun the plan's V-1..V-55/R-1..R-16 filters plus the new coverage for F1-F6, confirm the two regressions are fixed and no new ones introduced, then hand back to Review.

title: CARD-0527: fix F8/F9 commit-recovery defects
goal:
Fix two commit-recovery defects (F8/F9) found in CARD-0527's round-3 review (task 4d210064). Subject commit: 4d2a95508024253dddd647b6f9c8f71f63341da5 on branch feat/card-task-2853f966 (or feat/card-task-360e223e / feat/card-task-4d210064, all at the same tip - use whichever fetches cleanly), worktree C:\Antiphon\worktrees\card-task-2853f966 (fetch/checkout the branch first if not already at that tip).

F8 - post-commit inspection: if git commit succeeds but the subsequent SHA inspection fails, settlement can incorrectly report a refusal and spawn an unnecessary Commit child; if the committed-path inspection fails, it can report '0 files' instead of the real footprint. Fix: preserve the actual commit outcome through those inspection faults - the commit already happened and must not be lost or misreported. Add receipt regressions and named controls forcing each inspection to fail post-commit.

F9 - policy-change recovery: after a commit succeeds but the settlement save fails, if project or global CommitOnSettle policy flips to Off before the retry, the exact-commit lookup (the antiphon-task=<id> trailer search) gets bypassed by the now-Off policy check, and the parent can receive 'landed' instead of the actual committed SHA. Fix: recover the completed commit (via the trailer lookup) BEFORE applying the current policy check, so a policy flip during retry can never hide or mis-report an already-completed commit. Add policy-flip receipt tests and a named control.

Rerun Unit plus the named affected integration classes, confirm the six inherited failures are unchanged, then hand back to Review.
